kcc_query_text_example: Tenant cultivator farming 2.5 acres canal land in Gangavathi, Koppal under oral lease agreement; preparing for Rabi Bengalgram; no land title RTC in my name; applying for short-term crop loan at Prathama Grameena Bank; need tenant KCC eligibility rules.

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: Pure tenant / oral lease cultivator without registered land title record

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: NSS 77th Round: Pure tenant and sharecropping households in Tungabhadra command ayacut (Gangavathi taluk), commercial pulse cultivation.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka credit query logs: Tenant farmers asking about crop loan eligibility without RTC land ownership records.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 5 (Pure Tenant Exclusion & Credit Access) & Boundary Test: Exactly 2.5 acres is classified as Small [2.5, 5.0] inclusive lower boundary; pure tenant flag strictly triggers PM-KISAN exclusion (PMKISAN_PURE_TENANT_EXCLUSION); Central KCC-MISS permits credit delivery to sharecroppers/oral lessees via self-declaration/JLG route; General Merit category excludes corporation borewell schemes.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate PM-KISAN pure-tenant statutory exclusion; test 2.5-acre Small boundary point; verify tenant credit access via Central KCC-MISS.
unresolved_dependencies: RBI/NABARD district credit guidelines on tenant farmer oral lease crop loan limits for Koppal RRBs
